title: task records created in the main checkout reach a PR without manual carrying
body:
Source: lead session 2026-11-16: `krn task create` in the main checkout leaves an untracked tasks/<id>.json; three new records had to be handed to the successor as untracked files and carried into some later PR by hand.
Outcome: `krn task create` run in the main checkout writes the record onto a lead tracker branch (or the open lead worktree) and `krn task publish` ships all pending records in one PR through ship; the main checkout stays clean.
Why: tracker records got lost between sessions or rode along in unrelated PRs.
Proof: a task test creates two records from a main checkout fixture: `git status --porcelain` stays empty there and both records are on the tracker branch; publish produces one commit holding both.
Files: src/task/, src/cli/
